title: Design System: PLV Org Events Scheduling System

display.purpose: The page title (h1) inside x-ui.page-heading. One per page.

title.purpose: Panel titles and table-row primary text.

label.purpose: Form labels, buttons, nav items, table headers. Sentence case.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: All transitions and animations under prefers-reduced-motion (spinners keep turning).

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single primary action on a screen.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--color-primary); color: var(--color-primary-content); height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; font: 500 0.875rem/1 'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-primary) 88%, black); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Supporting actions next to a primary action.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: var(--color-base-100); color: var(--color-base-content); height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid var(--color-base-300); border-radius: 8px; font: 500 0.875rem/1 'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--color-base-200); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Label above, 40px field, hint or error below.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field-label { font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--color-base-content); } .ds-input { height: 40px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-base-content) 28%, var(--color-base-100)); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--color-base-100); color: var(--color-base-content); font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-input:focus { outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus); outline-offset: 0; border-color: var(--color-focus); }

components.name: Sidebar Nav Item
components.description: Portal navigation; navy fill marks the current page.
components.html: DashboardMy Tickets
components.css: .ds-nav { display: grid; gap: 4px; width: 240px; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-item { padding: 10px 12px; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-base-content) 80%, transparent); text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 150ms; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: var(--color-base-200); color: var(--color-base-content); } .ds-nav-item.is-active { background: var(--color-primary); color: var(--color-primary-content); }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Ticket status: soft tint, status-colored label and icon. Never color alone.
components.html: ✎ Needs revision ✓ Approved
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 8px; font: 500 0.75rem/1.4 'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-badge-warning { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-warning) 10%, var(--color-base-100)); color: var(--color-warning); } .ds-badge-success { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-success) 10%, var(--color-base-100)); color: var(--color-success); }

components.name: Panel
components.description: Flat paper-white panel with a hairline border; never a shadow at rest.
components.html:
Needs your review

Open a request to approve it, forward it to GSO, or ask for changes.
components.css: .ds-panel { background: var(--color-base-100); border: 1px solid var(--color-base-300); border-radius: 12px; padding: 20px; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--color-base-content); } .ds-panel h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-panel p { margin: 4px 0 0; font-size: 0.875rem; color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-base-content) 70%, transparent); }

narrative.overview: The interface should feel like the best-run office on campus: every request is logged, every folder has a clearly labeled status, the person at the desk tells you exactly what happens next, and nothing on the wall is there for decoration. Authority comes from order and precision, not from ornament. Surfaces are flat and quiet, grouped by hairline borders on a softly tinted canvas; color is spent almost entirely on status and on the one primary action per screen.
keyCharacteristics: Flat, bordered panels on a tinted canvas; shadows only on floating layers.
One typeface family (IBM Plex Sans) in four weights; IBM Plex Mono only for identifiers.
Navy for the single primary action and "you are here"; cyan only as a signal (focus, today, selection).
Status colors carry meaning and nothing else, always paired with a label and an icon.
Standard, familiar patterns everywhere: sidebar + top bar, tables, steppers, native controls.
150–200 ms state transitions; no entrance choreography; full prefers-reduced-motion support.

rules.name: The One Navy Rule
rules.body: Navy fills appear on at most one button per view (the primary action) plus the active navigation item.

rules.name: The Status Owns Color Rule
rules.body: Green, ochre, red, and info blue mean ticket state and feedback. They are forbidden as decoration.

rules.name: The Never Color Alone Rule
rules.body: Every status is shown as label + icon + color.

rules.name: The Sixty Floor Rule
rules.body: Text opacity never drops below base-content/60.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: IBM Plex Sans everywhere; Plex Mono only for identifiers.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Labels, buttons, table headers, and headings are sentence case; no tiny uppercase eyebrows.

rules.name: The Flat-at-Rest Rule
rules.body: A panel either has a border or a shadow, never both, and panels at rest always use the border.

rules.name: The Z-Scale Rule
rules.body: Sticky top bar 20, sidebar drawer 30, dropdown 40, modal 50, toast 60, tooltip 70.

dos: Do give each screen exactly one navy primary action and put it in the page header or at the end of the form.
Do show every ticket's status with the shared progress-badge (label + icon + color) and tell users the next step in words.
Do lead dashboards with the work queue.
Do keep panels flat: Paper White, 1px Hairline border, 12px radius, 20px padding.
Do keep :focus-visible rings on every control.
donts: Don't build the generic SaaS/AI dashboard: no gradient blobs, hero banners, walls of KPI cards, or quick-action tiles that repeat the sidebar.
Don't drift into the dated government portal: no walls of instructions, low-contrast gray text, or status shown as plain text.
Don't use the dark hacker tool aesthetic: no neon accents, glassmorphism, or glowing borders.
Don't use border-left/right wider than 1px as a colored stripe.
Don't use raw Tailwind grays; use theme tokens.
